name: Razan Saylami
description: Razan Saylami, director and production designer.
about: I am a Lebanese director and production designer, born and raised in the GCC, with over five years of experience across narrative films, music videos, and commercials. A graduate of the New York Film Academy, I’ve developed a practice grounded in strong visual language, bringing to life stories rooted in character, emotion, and the liminality of cultures. My heritage and experiences deeply influence my approach, conceptualisation and visual expression. As a director and production designer, the heart of my work lies in developing creative concepts that translate ideas and stories into cohesive cinematic experiences. These endeavours have led to my work being featured in several critically acclaimed projects, including festival-winning films.
